name: pathseek
title: PathSeek
description: Find files and folders fast, open them, or select paths in macOS Open/Save dialogs. Index only when you choose.
author: liyunfeng

preferences.name: includeHidden
preferences.title: Include Hidden Files
preferences.description: Include hidden files and directories when rebuilding the index.
preferences.label: Include hidden paths

preferences.name: followSymlinks
preferences.title: Follow Symbolic Links
preferences.description: Follow symlinked directories (can cause extensive traversal).
preferences.label: Follow symlinked directories

preferences.name: excludePatterns
preferences.title: Exclude Patterns
preferences.description: Optional fd glob patterns to exclude, separated by commas.

preferences.name: fdBinary
preferences.title: fd Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path. Default: find fd in Homebrew, Cargo or PATH.

preferences.name: fzfBinary
preferences.title: fzf Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path. Default: find fzf in Homebrew or PATH.

preferences.name: enableCommandTracing
preferences.title: Developer: Trace fd/fzf Calls
preferences.description: Record sanitized command calls, reasons, exit states and durations locally. Off by default.
preferences.label: Enable developer execution trace

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files and Folders
commands.description: Search indexed files and folders, then open or reveal them in Finder.

commands.name: dialog-search
commands.title: Find in Open/Save
commands.description: Find a file or folder and paste its path into the original Open/Save dialog.

commands.name: rebuild-index
commands.title: Build Index
commands.description: Choose which folders to index, then build or update the index manually.

commands.name: index-status
commands.title: View Index Status
commands.description: See indexed folders, file counts, and the time of the last rebuild.

commands.name: debug-info
commands.title: View Diagnostics
commands.description: View or copy privacy-safe diagnostics for troubleshooting.
